Question Choices: A fish is at -18 m and a turtle is at -11 m (below sea level). Who is farther from sea level?
Hints: Farther from sea level means a greater absolute value of the position.
Solution: The fish is |-18| = 18 m from sea level. The turtle is |-11| = 11 m away. Since 18 > 11, the fish is farther away.
